Tincture is a wavetable synthesizer VST3 for Ableton Live.

Unzip and copy `Tincture.vst3` to:

- macOS: `~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/`
- Windows: `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\`
- Linux: `~/.vst3/`

then rescan plug-ins in your DAW.

The macOS build isn't notarised. If macOS says the plug-in can't be opened,
run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Tincture.vst3`.
